exposure: number of abnormal oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) values
outcome: adverse perinatal composite (pre-eclampsia, preterm delivery, macrosomia, primary cesarean section)
adverse neonatal composite (birth trauma, neonatal hypoglycemia, hyperbilirubinemia, stillbirth/perinatal mortality)
cohort: The study included 4869 pregnant women from six Finnish hospitals, identified through the Finnish Medical Birth Register 2009, who had oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) laboratory data.
finding: Women with at least two abnormal oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) values had significantly higher risks of adverse perinatal and neonatal composite outcomes compared to women with only one abnormal value.
mod_finding: Primary cesarean section was included as an outcome in the adverse perinatal composite, showing an increased risk for women with at least two abnormal OGTT values.
